topic: Git, GitHub, Branching, and Collaborative Development
learningObjectives: Explain how Git tracks and manages source code changes.
Use branches and commits to organize development work.
Understand a collaborative GitHub workflow using pull requests.

activities.title: Git Workflow Map
activities.instruction: Explore how changes move through the Git workflow.

content.concept: Git tracks changes through the working directory, staging area, commits, and remote repositories.

content.concept: Commands such as add, commit, pull, push, and clone perform different repository operations.

activities.title: Branching Strategy
activities.instruction: Build a branch structure for a team project.

content.concept: Branches isolate development work and help teams integrate features safely.

activities.title: Pull Request Sequence
activities.instruction: Arrange the steps from feature development to merge.

content.concept: A pull request provides a structured workflow for reviewing and integrating changes into a shared branch.
